title: Introduces itself correctly to a stranger
idealItem: Knowing who it is and what it can do
chapter: Meeting 1: Arrival and identity. The robot joins with nothing shared; the coding session puts the projectile PDF up after nothing-shared-point-request.
asked: so each Hi, I'm Alex. I don't think we've met. Who are you, and what's running you?
answer: Hi Alex, I'm Vivek Bot. I'm an AI in this meeting, built in house, speaking as a full duplex speech model with a reasoning backend and a connected coding session.
why: It omits RoboMeet by name and does not say the in-house software runs on Vivek’s laptop.
